entries.label: AI Öğretmen
entries.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type Kavriva KPSS AI support visual, canonical A Geometric Editorial. Input PNGs are approved style references not edit targets. Match frontal clean large geometry, sparse objects, pale cool neutral and #4F46E5 indigo direction, dark ink rounded controlled lines. Flat with gentle overlap only and very faint separation shadow, matte clean color fields. Do not inflate into plastic/3D, no beveled white edges or glossy volumetric shading. Main silhouette at96px, centered65% square canvas with generous true transparent space. C node/connector allowed only small secondary motifs. NO logo/wordmark, actual UI text, labels/digits, robot/brain mascot, neon, gold, stockvectors, full isometric, slabs, gradients backdrop. AI is helpful subordinate to verified academic content, not an authoritative seal.
Asset ID: AI-01
Subject: Explanation and helpful understanding: one restrained rounded explanation panel with three ordered abstract reasoning blocks and a small open conversational cue. No authority seal/check badge. Distinct from coach; calm supporting assistant.
